question: What is the primary definition of Artificial Intelligence (AI)?
options: The simulation of human intelligence processes by computer systems
The physical assembly of mechanical robots
The storage of large volumes of database records
The manual creation of complex algorithms by humans
answer: The simulation of human intelligence processes by computer systems
